Color.description: A colour: "#rrggbb" or [r, g, b] with values 0–255.

Density.description: The density in g/cm³: above 0 and at most 1000.

input.description:
Define a physical material in this design: a name, a density and an optional default look
and physical card. Assign it with `material.assign`. One undo step.

appearance.description: The look, a library appearance by name (see `appearance.library`). Not with `color`.

color.description: The look's colour, `"#rrggbb"` or [r, g, b] (0–255), not with `appearance`. `null` clears the material's look, so its bodies show the default.

name.description:
The new material's name: 1 to 128 characters, not a built-in material's or another of the
design's (letter case doesn't matter). Spaces at either end are dropped.

opacity.description: The look's opacity: needs `appearance` or `color`. Default: 1, or the appearance's own.

pbr.description: The look's opaque PBR response; it needs `appearance` or `color`, and an opaque look. `null` selects scalar shading. Left out, a library appearance keeps its own response.

anyOf.description: A schema_version 1 engineering material card in SI units (see docs/physical-material-cards.md).

physical_card.description: A validated physical material card in SI units (see docs/physical-material-cards.md). The card's density never changes the assigned density. `null`: no card (an edit clears it). Left out: none for a new material; an edit keeps the current one.

input.title: MaterialCreateParams

label: New Physical Material

CardModuli.description: The isotropic moduli a card's numbers imply.

analysis_solver_available.description: Always false: there is no analysis solver.

isotropic_moduli.description: The shear and bulk moduli an isotropic card's numbers imply.

missing_condition_fields.description: Per property kind: the condition fields it lacks.

property_kinds.description: The kinds of property the card gives.

rendering_properties_available.description: Always false: a card holds no rendering properties.

source_review_required.description: The sources the card's properties cite, which still need review.

unspecified_conditions.description:
The property kinds given without every condition they hold at (temperature, state, and
moisture for wood or strain rate for polymers).

DensityComparison.description: A card's measured density against the material's assigned one.

relative_difference.description: Their difference as a share of the larger.

LookReply.description: A look, as the appearance commands report it.

name.description:
The library appearance's or recipe's name, or the look's label (`Custom` for a plain
colour).

pbr.description: Its opaque PBR response, when it has one.

PbrReply.description: A look's PBR response, as the appearance commands report it.

output.description: What `material.create` and `material.edit` return: the material as the design now defines it.

appearance.description: The default look; `null` when it has none.

bodies.description: After an edit: the bodies the material is assigned to.

density_comparison.description: How the card's measured density compares with the assigned one, when the card gives one.

density_g_cm3.description: The assigned density (g/cm³), the one masses use.

param_warnings.description: In the warn parameter-check mode: what the call's parameters got wrong.

physical_card.description: Its physical card, when it has one.

physical_validation.description: The card's check, when it has a card.

user.description: Always true: a material this design defines.

output.title: MaterialReply

params: name (not a built-in material's); density_g_cm3: (0, 1000]; appearance?: library name (appearance.library) | color?: "#rrggbb" or [r, g, b] (0–255), opacity? (0–1), pbr?: {metallic:0..1, roughness:0.045..1, dielectric_ior:1..3} (opaque only, needs color/appearance): the default look. A named appearance keeps its preset response when pbr is omitted; pbr: null selects scalar shading. Optical edits do not change density. physical_card?: validated SI candidate record (null/omitted means unknown); card density never changes assigned density. Assign it with material.assign
